name: Marking the 200-metre lanes on the Banyan Maidan
subject: events
brief: Four of you are laying out the Saturday morning inter-house heats on the Banyan Maidan: wheeling the lime marker along the curves, pegging the staggered start strings, and writing out the lane-draw board. You keep the sports-fund tally, and morning walkers plus a junior football kick-about leave almost no clear turf to meet.

tasks.name: Wheel the wet-lime hopper around the four lane curves
Measure and peg the 200-metre stagger offsets
Chalk the heat numbers and lane draws on the blackboard

facts.text: Tara taped her ankle before the district trials and must not push the heavy lime hopper
Nasrin has two boxes of dustless coloured chalk from the games cupboard

note: Uses the Banyan Maidan (loc_banyan_maidan), Tara Das (npc_tara_das) and Ishan Sheikh (npc_ishan_sheikh) from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md. The constraint is capacity: Tara's taped ankle means she cannot push the heavy lime hopper, which only talking to her shows, so the work must be rebalanced. The seam: the pegged staggers are measured in metres and the lane-draw board assumes lane widths in feet.
